about.heroSubtitle: We're on a mission to connect people with the best beauty professionals in their neighborhood, making self-care easy and affordable.
about.missionDescription: To empower everyone to look and feel their best by connecting them with trusted beauty professionals.
about.visionDescription: A world where quality beauty services are accessible, affordable, and just a tap away.
about.valuesDescription: Trust, transparency, and community are at the heart of everything we do.
about.howItStarted1: Henzo was born from a simple question: Why is finding a reliable beauty salon in Vietnam still so difficult in 2024?
about.howItStarted2: After researching the Vietnamese beauty market, we discovered that talented salon owners lack affordable tools for online booking, while customers waste time calling salons to check availability.
about.howItStarted3: We're building Henzo to solve this. Currently in development, we're preparing for beta launch with partner salons. Join us on this journey - it's free for beta program.
about.roadmapSubtitle: We're just getting started - here's our journey from idea to platform
about.roadmapProblemDescription: Identified the challenge: Vietnamese beauty salons struggle with online booking, while clients can't easily find and compare services.
about.roadmapMVPDescription: Developed core platform: salon profiles, service listings, online booking system, and review functionality.
about.roadmapBetaDescription: Launching beta with first partner salons in Da Nang.
about.roadmapVisionDescription: Scale to 100+ salons, mobile app, loyalty programs, and advanced analytics for salon owners.
about.valuesSectionSubtitle: Our core values guide every decision we make and shape the Henzo experience
about.trustSafetyDescription: Every salon is verified and reviewed. We prioritize your safety and satisfaction above all.
about.customerFirstDescription: Your beauty journey matters to us. We're committed to providing exceptional service every step of the way.
about.communityDrivenDescription: We build connections between beauty professionals and clients, fostering a supportive community.
about.innovationDescription: Constantly improving our platform with the latest technology to enhance your experience.
about.qualityStandardsDescription: We partner only with the best professionals who meet our rigorous quality criteria.
about.growthTogetherDescription: We succeed when our salons and customers thrive. Your growth is our growth.
about.ctaSubtitle: Download the Henzo app and get exclusive access to special deals, instant booking, and personalized recommendations.
